sources.title: Maractus Powerful Needles
sources.supports: Flip once per supplied Energy unit; damage is 60 per heads.

sources.title: Twin Energy
sources.supports: The card provides two Colorless units outside V/GX, so a card and its supplied units are distinct.

sources.title: Zebstrika Sprint FAQ
sources.supports: Sprint is usable with no hand cards or with only one card left in the deck.

sources.title: Rayquaza VMAX Azure Pulse FAQ
sources.supports: Azure Pulse can draw with no hand cards; draw one when only one deck card remains.

sources.title: Fire Crystal
sources.supports: Recover three Fire Energy cards from discard to hand.

sources.title: Diancie Diamond Rain FAQ
sources.supports: Heal each own Benched Pokemon after damage; pending KO does not remove a healing-blocking ability before the heal.

sources.title: Iron Bundle Refrigerated Stream
sources.supports: The defending Evolution Pokemon cannot attack next turn.

sources.title: Raikou Electro Fall
sources.supports: Add 90 at the four-unit own-field Energy threshold; the Lightning type is retained from the local original English card text.

sources.title: Advanced rule guide
sources.supports: Do as much as possible for fixed counts; extra damage is calculated before weakness and resistance.

scope: 96 newly supported components (86 attacks, 8 abilities, 2 Trainers), 48 fully supported cards.
boundaries: Only complete recognized clauses are mapped; unresolved abilities keep whole cards unsupported.
Dynamic Energy flips count supplied units, with typed filters where printed; counter flips count current damage counters and are not truncated at twenty.
Whole-hand discard is not a one-card activation cost; empty hand and short deck are legal when an effect remains.
Typed discard recovery counts cards and requires as many as available, capped at the printed amount.
